summary: Independent-review fixes to r0050 Weather diagnostics: read-only config lookup (no more WeatherConfig.load()/AmberAlertConfig.load() get_or_create side effects); wx_alert artifact state now derives from active watch/warning+AMBER evidence instead of treating a historical file/Track as ready; file facts carry exists evidence for Admin; one file-age check now uses the snapshot's injected clock. No schema, network, TTS, subprocess, or on-air behavior change.
